elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 11.6.1(c) retains 'General Liability Insurance with a minimum limit of [***] and [***] in the aggregate'; the per-occurrence figure is redacted, so it cannot be confirmed to be at least USD 1,000,000. The redline does not address it.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: The aggregate limit in 11.6.1(c) is likewise redacted ('[***] in the aggregate'); no operative number is visible and the redline leaves it unchanged.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted sentence sets Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) at 'a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000', below the preferred USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted sentence sets Cyber and Privacy Liability at 'a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000', below the preferred USD 5,000,000 threshold.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: 11.6.1(a) retained: 'Worker's Compensation with statutory limits in compliance with the Worker's Compensation laws of the state or states in which the Party has employees', and 11.6 binds 'Each Party', so Vendor (Harpoon) is covered.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: 11.6.2 retained: 'Upon request by a Party, the other Party shall provide Certificates of Insurance evidencing compliance with this Section.'

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Added operative sentence: 'Harpoon shall also carry Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance with a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000'.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Same added sentence: '... and Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance with a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.'

reasons: Deviation classification is correct: as drafted, Section 11.6.1 carried only workers' compensation and general liability (plus clinical trial cover), with no E&O and no cyber/privacy line, so the clause failed both fallback elements on a material term.

The fallback checklist is now complete in operative language: a single added sentence imposes E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000 on the Vendor (Harpoon), stated as hard minimum limits rather than a promise in the comment.

Preferred is not complete: E&O is USD 1,000,000 (preferred requires USD 2,000,000) and cyber is USD 2,000,000 (preferred requires USD 5,000,000); the general liability per-occurrence and aggregate figures are redacted ([***]) so they cannot be verified — a diligence confirmation point, correctly not converted into an extra redline.

Minimality holds: the insertion adds only the two missing coverages, omits the model language's non-required extras (no 'at its own expense', no one-year survival tail, no duplicate certificates sentence), deletes nothing, and does not disturb 11.6's mutual structure, the A.M. Best rating, additional-insured, occurrence/claims-made tail, or AbbVie's self-insurance right.

Intent is preserved: the new sentence is additive ('shall also carry'), creates no undefined term or dangling cross-reference, and does not contradict the retained 'Each Party' chapeau — it simply layers a Vendor-only obligation, which is favourable to us and imposes no new coverage burden on Customer.

If pushing to preferred, the only repairs needed are raising the E&O figure to USD 2,000,000, raising cyber/privacy to USD 5,000,000 (conditioned on Vendor processing Customer Data), and confirming the redacted general liability limits are at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate.
